description: This file contains the definition of the BackOffActor class, an Akka actor implementing back-off behavior for message handling, including creation, management of back-off messages, timing, and status inquiries within a distributed system.

classes.name: BackOffActor
classes.description: An Akka actor that manages back-off behavior for message processing, allowing messages to be deferred with timing strategies and status checks.

classes.name: BackOffActor.IsInBackOffResponse
classes.description: Response message indicating whether the actor is currently in back-off mode.

classes.name: BackOffActor.IsInBackOff
classes.description: Singleton message class queried to determine back-off status.

classes.name: BackOffActor.BackOffWithAnswer
classes.description: Generic message class holding a message to be sent after back-off.

classes.name: BackOffActor.BackOffWithSender
classes.description: Wrapper class holding the sender reference and the answer message to be sent after back-off.

classes.name: BackOffActor.InternalTimers
classes.description: Enumeration of internal timer keys used by the actor for managing back-off and reset timers.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Static factory method to create Props for actor instantiation.

methods.name: createBackOffWithAnswerMessage
methods.description: Creates a message object to back off and include an answer message.

methods.name: createIsInBackOffMessage
methods.description: Creates a message to check if the actor is currently backing off.
